scope: India national IBJA benchmark estimate; not city retail or jewellery pricing
method: Verified IBJA rate × observed global metal ratio × paired currency-reference ratio.
validity: Conditional market-implied estimate. Scenario range describes historical moves and is not a calibrated probability.

gold24.label: 24K gold
gold24.description: Last verified IBJA rate adjusted by observed same-provider global metal and USD/INR ratios since its first paired source check.

wider_range.method: 80th percentile of past absolute IBJA daily moves. Descriptive scenario, not a calibrated prediction interval.

scenario_basis.method: 80th percentile of past absolute IBJA daily moves. Descriptive scenario, not a calibrated prediction interval.

forward_evidence.note: Forward results from forecasts saved before the target day. Latest saved issue per target date; no historical simulation is presented as live accuracy.

validation.description: Market-implied parity assumption; forward errors are measured against actual target-date PM closes.

assumptions: Global metal and FX levels hold until the next IBJA publication.
Domestic taxes and the local market premium remain unchanged.
Reference market quotes were captured at the first verified benchmark check, not at an assumed IBJA publication time.
limitations: This is an experimental market-implied projection, not a fitted or proven predictive model.
MCX, COMEX and LBMA feeds are not connected.
The provider conversion accompanies a gold quote; an independent FX tick timestamp is not available.
